title: Bonds to increase safety, security; repair schools, update classrooms
ballot_label: Caption: Bonds to increase safety, security; repair schools, update classrooms (Question and summary not retrieved.)
summary: North Clackamas School District general obligation bond measure. The district describes a proposed $245 million Capital Construction Bond to upgrade technology, cooling and roofing systems at every district school, which it says would not increase the current tax rate.
yes_means: A yes vote authorizes the North Clackamas School District to issue general obligation bonds for school safety, security, repairs and classroom updates.
no_means: A no vote does not authorize the bonds.
fiscal_impact: District states: proposed $245 million Capital Construction Bond, 'without increasing your current tax rate' (district bond page, published 2026-07-06). Official ballot-title estimate not retrieved.
